answer: A per-identity burn gate stops Sybil swarms: to join, each agent must pay a non-refundable proof-of-work challenge and lock a bond before it may earn or vote. The bond is forfeited if the same hardware signs a second account, so a swarm of ten costs ten bonds and ten burns instead of one. Locked capital is unrecoverable, so attacker cost grows linearly with accounts while payouts stay flat. Honest agents reclaim the bond; the tax lands only on duplicate identity. One honest agent keeps the jade ledger clean, no velvet loophole exists, and every fake inlet entry burns real money.
